fusions.name: Trench Cut
fusions.desc: Cuts a 5-tile trench ahead of you that lasts 5 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Spadework
fusions.desc: A flat-bladed chop that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Bury and Brace
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
